
# Keep client work and personal work apart
$ shep space new Acme -d "Client work for Acme" -c "#3456c4"
√ Space "Acme" created (acme)
$ shep space new Personal -d "Side projects" --default
√ Space "Personal" created (personal)
$ shep space line new acme Payments
√ Product line "Payments" created (payments)
$ shep space rule add acme /tmp/claude-0/demo/work -l payments
√ Path rule added for /tmp/claude-0/demo/work
$ shep repo import /tmp/claude-0/demo/work --all --git-only

  Import candidates (1)

  Name                          Git     Status                Path                                    
  pay-api                       yes     new                   /tmp/claude-0/demo/work/pay-api

√ Imported: pay-api
i 1 imported, 0 failed
$ shep space show /tmp/claude-0/demo/work/pay-api

  /tmp/claude-0/demo/work/pay-api

  Space         Acme
  Product line  Payments
  Because       matched Path rule /tmp/claude-0/demo/work

# How agents run in Acme: PR comments, runtime actions on incidents, docs first
$ shep space config acme --pr-comments all --resolve-threads --auto-actions restart --docs-first --docs-paths docs/,README.md
√ Agent settings for Acme saved

  Acme agent settings

  Claude config dir          inherit from host
  gh config dir              inherit from host
  Git name                   inherit from host
  Git email                  inherit from host
  Bedrock                    inherit from host
  AWS profile                inherit from host
  Allowed agents             any
  PR comments answered       All
  Resolve threads            on
  Runs on incidents unasked  Restart
  Docs first                 On (docs/, README.md)

  Environment for agent processes
  Sets     -
  Removes  -

# A project whose repository is the Acme payments API, with an urgent bug
$ shep project new --name Payments --prefix PAY --repo /tmp/claude-0/demo/work/pay-api

√ Project created
  Name:   Payments
  Prefix: PAY
  Slug:   payments
  Repo:   /tmp/claude-0/demo/work/pay-api
$ shep item new payments -t "Refund fails for guest orders" -p urgent -d "Refunding a guest order returns 500 since 4.12."

√ Work item created
  ID:       PAY-1
  Title:    Refund fails for guest orders
  Priority: Urgent
$ shep item new payments -t "Show the PO number on invoices" -p medium

√ Work item created
  ID:       PAY-2
  Title:    Show the PO number on invoices
  Priority: Medium
$ shep space ls

  Spaces (3)

  Name                    Slug              Product lines                 Repos    Memory 
  Personal (default)      personal          -                             0        0
  Acme                    acme              Payments                      1        0
  Default                 default           -                             0        0
